item.title: Katsuura Tuna: Japan's Great Fresh-Tuna Port — Guide
item.description: Nachikatsuura is Japan’s leading port for fresh, never-frozen tuna, landing more of it than anywhere else in the country thanks to a fleet that uses longlines rather than nets, bringing the fish in whole and undamaged. On most mornings the market floor fills with rows of gleaming tuna as buyers inspect and bid, and visitors can watch the whole auction free from a dedicated gallery above — a genuine working market rather than a show.
